title: scoreboard
description: Tracks and displays scores for various objectives. See more information about its use in the [Scoreboards Objectives Commands documentation](/creator/documents/scoreboardintroduction#scoreboard-objectives-commands) page.

objective.title: objective
objective.description: Objective for the game to track

displayname.title: displayName
displayname.description: A `string` for the display name. Default: `<objective>`.

playername.title: playername
playername.description: A [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors), player selector, UUID, unique ID, or `*` for all of the score havers.

player.title: player
player.description: A player name `string` or [`target selector`](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors) to identify the player.

count.title: count
count.description: An `integer` to set the score to.

targetname.title: targetName
targetname.description: A [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors), player selector, UUID, unique ID, or `*` for all of the score havers.

operation.title: operation
operation.description: A command operator of the `operation` to be applied. Must be `=`, `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`, `*/`, `<>`, `<`, or. `>`.

selector.title: selector
selector.description: A [target selector](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandsintroduction#target-selectors), player selector, UUID, unique ID, or `*` for all of the source score havers to use as source inputs.
